categories.description: Legacy HS-STEEL detail block DWGs (HSSTEEL/block/*.dwg): frames, tables, notes, marks, anchors, lugs...
Legacy section/plate/deck/grating tables (HSSTEEL/attributes/*.dat)
Legacy SCSS bolted splice tables (HSSTEEL/attributes/SCSS-*.dat)
Legacy Project.dat default fabrication settings
Legacy new-project set (HSSTEEL/새공사-설치용): dat, template dwg, BOM workbook, plot style, scripts
Legacy linetype / multiline style files (*.lin, *.mln)
Legacy font mapping (*.fmp)
Legacy command alias file (*.pgp)
Legacy dialog definitions (*.DCL, *.xpg)
Legacy tool palette definitions (*.atc, *.xtp)
Legacy quantity/estimate workbooks (*.xlsx, *.xlsm)
Legacy section/detail preview slides (*.sld)
Legacy ribbon/toolbar/palette icons, one asset per folder (props.members lists the files)
Legacy menus/ribbons and compiled plugins (reference only: command catalog)
Legacy plot styles and batch-plot tool (reference only)
Legacy manuals and memos (reference only)
Real legacy project sets used as regression oracles (reference only)
Layer standard of generated shop drawings (HsSteel.Drafting.Layers)
Text style definitions created in the target drawing when missing (HsSteel.Drafting.TextStyles)
Dimension style definitions created in the target drawing when missing (HsSteel.Drafting.TextStyles)
Sheet frame (도곽) model (HsSteel.Drafting.SheetFrame); the company frame replaces it via hs_frame_set
Shop-drawing sheet generators (HsSteel.Drafting) and the drawing set composer
Callouts, weld symbols, bolt notes and dimension helpers (HsSteel.Drafting)
Code data tables: scales, weld/bolt tables, assembly mark heads, paper constants
Project standard options and fabrication detail rules (HsSteel.Domain)
Evidence-backed detailing rules catalog (rules.json / docs/RULES_CATALOG.md)
Cross-section shape kinds supported by the drawing engine (HsSteel.Domain.ShapeKind)
Connection kinds of the project model (HsSteel.Modeling ConnectionDef subtypes)
Parametric project model templates (HsSteel.Modeling.ProjectTemplates)
